```{=html}
<script>
/* Adds an actual read link to each Trends entry without changing post URLs.
   Idempotent for Quarto listing refreshes. */
(function () {
  function addReadLinks() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.quarto-listing-default .quarto-post').forEach(function (post) {
      if (post.querySelector('.pic-entry-read')) return;
      var titleLink = post.querySelector('.listing-title a[href]');
      var body = post.querySelector('.body');
      if (!titleLink || !body) return;
      var link = document.createElement('a');
      link.className = 'pic-entry-read';
      link.href = titleLink.getAttribute('href');
      link.textContent = '원문 읽기';
      body.appendChild(link);
    });
  }
  function initialize() {
    if (!document.querySelector('.pic-trends-marker')) return;
    addReadLinks();
    var listing = document.querySelector('#quarto-listing-container-default') ||
                  document.querySelector('.quarto-listing-container') ||
                  document.querySelector('main.content');
    if (listing) {
      new MutationObserver(addReadLinks).observe(listing, {childList: true, subtree: true});
    }
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initialize, {once: true});
  } else {
    initialize();
  }
})();
</script>
```
